title: Better Glow Lichen
description: Changes the texture of Glow Lichen.
body:
Turns Glow Lichen into a shiny, diamond-like texture that looks impressively convincing. Perfect for pranking friends, confusing players, or flexing fake riches in builds without actually changing gameplay at all.
